question.text: Which sector recorded the highest growth rate in Pakistan in fiscal year 2025-26 according to the Economic Survey 2025-26?
question.explanation: Services grew about 4.09 percent, ahead of industry at about 3.51 percent and agriculture at about 2.89 percent.

question.text: In January 2025 the World Bank Group announced a ten-year Country Partnership Framework for Pakistan of approximately what value?
question.explanation: The World Bank Group announced a Country Partnership Framework for Pakistan worth about US$40 billion over ten years, covering 2026-2035.

question.text: Which head of state visited Pakistan in February 2025 for a meeting of the High Level Strategic Cooperation Council, during which 24 documents were exchanged?
options: President Recep Tayyip Erdogan of Türkiye
question.explanation: Turkish President Erdogan visited Islamabad on 12-13 February 2025 for the Pakistan-Türkiye High Level Strategic Cooperation Council.
